release.name: Blossom
release.author: Izumi
release.description: A phone-first Material You look in soft pink over violet-black, with very round corners, a mesh glow and Nunito. Home opens on a featured card that pairs the cover with the title, score and pill actions, then rounded poster rows and card-style resume stills. The series page shows chips for score, format, episodes and season with a thumbnail episode list. Desktop uses the same palette with a wider banner.
